description: Environmental Planning Instrument - Transport and Arterial Road Infrastructure is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. The data represents the Transport Arterial Rd Infra for Environmental Planning Instrument. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. Its tags are EPI, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, Transport Arterial Rd Infra, planning. It offers 3 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, json, pdf. The portal shows 2025-10-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
